description: Asks, on a writable copy, which unbracketed words CREATE TABLE refuses as a column name through Database.Execute (dbFailOnError): each statement is CREATE TABLE Rc<i> (<word> LONG) for the words listed in the probe (SQL keywords, type names, function names and constants such as Name, Date, Text, Value, Order, Group, Table, Count, Year, Type, Level, Key, User, Time, Note, Desc, Min, Null, True, Password, Owner, Comment, Description, Field, Column, Row, Data, Primary, Check, Constraint, Create, Drop, Alter, Add, Update, Delete, Insert, Values, Set, Join, On, As, By, Is, In, Like, Not, And, Or, All, Any, Union, Distinct, Top), with no DBEngine.Errors read between them. At the end the TableDefs names are listed, so that refused words are the missing tables. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
